title: Goal board
description: The work ledger this bot conducts: the goal, the round it is on, and every item with its state, the conductor's decision, the acceptance verdict and the worker's own last report. Read from the work slot fold, so an item's state here is the state the conductor recorded. An item whose worker conducts a board of its own shows that board's tasks nested under it, read from the workstreams slot fold, so a child conductor's workers are on this page too. One field is the conductor's own: asks, keyed by item id, each {options: [short strings]} -- the answers it offers for an item waiting on the reader. Each needs-you row gets a Reply button and one button per option; Reply only fills the reader's chat box, and an option is sent in one click only when the reader turned one-click sends on, otherwise it fills the chat box too. A row with no entry still gets Reply, so the page works with no write at all.

upkeep.means: the answers you offer for each item waiting on the person, keyed by item id
upkeep.when: in the same turn a question for the person opens or is answered
upkeep.how: set {item_id: {options: [short answers]}}; drop the entry once they answer; write it with dashboard_write; call dashboard_fields first for its shape
